body:

[artcvan] I'm in the education store right now and there is no mention of either the $150 from PayPal or the "Eco-Voucher" being applicable in the Offers section when preordering anything. Also did not receive any emails from Samsung for Eco-Vouchers on my edu email.
Trade in bonus I'm unsure if it applies but it also does not show up under Offers like it does on the regular store. So seems to just be the phone with no offers other than the 25% off discount.

[artcvan] Yep I stand corrected it seems. Worth mentioning that the loyalty voucher does also work on Edu store so it seems like Samsung is just not promoting it but it does still apply anyway.

UNFOLD2026 code will ONLY APPLY if the total final value of ecosystem products in cart is a minimum $150 (post any discounts)
